_comment: Filled in as scenarios are actually implemented, not ahead of reality — see docs/scenarios/ for what's actually built.

components.name: Frontend App
components.description: Demo UI — register/login, create a short link, visit it

details.purpose: The only thing an actual person interacts with in this whole stack
Owns the auth-service.users schema; the only writer to it

components.name: LinkApi
components.description: Creates short links (hash generated here), reads them back through a cache

details.purpose: POST /links generates the hash and publishes it; GET /links/{hash} is a cached read against Postgres

components.name: RedirectApi
components.description: Resolves a short link and issues a 302

details.purpose: Cache-first read of the same Links table LinkApi writes; 404 on unknown hash

components.name: RabbitMQ
components.description: Durable queue between LinkApi and ShortenerService

details.purpose: Decouples the synchronous hash response from the actual Postgres write
details.topology: topic exchange "events", queue "shortener-service.link-created" bound to routing key "link.created" — declared by the app itself, not a static definitions.json

links.config: infra/rabbitmq/definitions.json (unused placeholder, see its own comment)

components.name: ShortenerService
components.description: Consumes LinkCreatedEvent, persists the link to Postgres

details.purpose: Owns the shortener-service.links schema; the only writer, redelivery-safe (skips if the hash is already stored)

components.name: TrafficService
components.description: Running, but idle — click-tracking consumer is scenario 2 work

details.purpose: Owns the traffic-service.clicks schema (migrated, unused). No consumer wired up yet.

components.name: Redis
components.description: Cache of hash → link, shared key format between LinkApi and RedirectApi

details.purpose: Cache-aside: read-through on miss, populated by whichever service reads or creates first

components.name: Postgres
components.description: Single instance, one linkshortener DB, 3 schemas — no sharding yet

details.purpose: auth-service.users, shortener-service.links, traffic-service.clicks — one schema per owning service

connections.label: Visit the short link
connections.protocol: HTTP (browser navigation, not fetch — not subject to CORS)

connections.label: Publish LinkCreatedEvent
connections.format: { hash, originalLink, shortenLink, createdAt, userId? } → JSON, routing key "link.created"
connections.notes: Falls back to a local SQLite queue if the broker is unreachable; retried every 30s.

scenarios.name: Minimal stack
scenarios.description: Register/login, create a short link, resolve it. RabbitMQ already decouples the write; no sharding, replicas, or click tracking yet.
scenarios.focus: Cache-aside reads, eventual consistency on the write path, connection pooling patterns (AddDbContextPool vs AddPooledDbContextFactory)
